o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یوز (yüz), from Proto-Turkic *yǖŕ (“face”). Cognate with Turkish yüz (“face”).
Borrowed from Classical Persian سفارش (sifāriš) / سپارش (sipāriš). Doublet of sifariş.
